subject.title: Feature: Private Mode for demos and content creation

question: What privacy guarantee should private mode make across local persistence, workspace/tool access, channel activation, and remote provider usage before a public API or UI toggle is introduced?
rationale: The feature crosses durable session state, workspace access, channel semantics, and potentially external providers; an incomplete implementation could create a false security expectation.

options.title: Approve a strict private-session contract
options.body: Define a fail-closed per-session capability with documented persistence and provider boundaries, then implement it across all identified surfaces.

options.title: Scope to a narrower demo mode
options.body: Limit the first release to suppressing workspace bootstrap context and label it clearly as not a no-persistence privacy guarantee.

options.title: Defer pending threat-model design
options.body: Keep the tracker open until owners agree on channel, restart, provider, and persistence semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve a strict private-session contract
recommendation.body: Define a fail-closed per-session capability with documented persistence and provider boundaries, then implement it across all identified surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent review and session-surface history make this the strongest available routing candidate for the required contract decision.
